meta.title: Take a scan — Palsya
meta.description: A guided face capture with live lighting, sharpness and framing checks.

scan.title: New scan
scan.cameraUnavailableTitle: The camera is not available here.
scan.tip1: Face a window, or put a lamp in front of you — never to one side. Side light reads as asymmetry.
scan.tip2: Same place and same time of day each week, if you can.
scan.tip3: No glasses, hair off the face, chin level.
scan.tip4: Prop the device up rather than holding it.
scan.qualityAllGood: Lighting, sharpness, and framing all check out. Measured brightness {mean}, left-to-right difference {evenness}.
scan.poorQualityBody: A scan taken in bad light or out of focus produces a number that looks like a measurement and is not one. We would rather you fixed the light first.
scan.captureNote: The camera and the image-quality checks are real. Your frames stay on this device for you to review and are discarded when you leave this page.

errors.noApi: This browser does not expose a camera API.
errors.insecure: Browsers only allow camera access over a secure (https) connection.
errors.denied: Camera permission was declined. You can change it from the padlock icon in your address bar.
errors.notFound: No camera was found on this device.
errors.generic: The camera could not be started.

position.title: Line your face up
position.msg: Fill the outline with your face
position.sub: Straight on, chin level, both ears visible if you can.

rest.title: Rest
rest.msg: Let your face go completely blank
rest.sub: No smile, no frown. Eyes open, looking at the camera.

brow.title: Raise your brows
brow.sub: As if mildly surprised. Hold it while we capture.

smile.title: Gentle smile
smile.sub: About a third of your maximum. Not a big one.

eyes.title: Close your eyes
eyes.sub: As if falling asleep. Do not squeeze.

dark.fix: Face a window or turn a light on in front of you.

bright.fix: Move away from the light source or close a blind.

uneven.t: Light is coming from one side
uneven.fix: Side light creates shadow that reads as asymmetry. Turn to face the light.

blur.fix: Hold the device steady and clean the lens.

flat.fix: More light, and step back from a plain bright wall.

motion.fix: Prop the device up if you can.

review.title: Check your frames
review.sub: One frame for each step, as the camera saw it.
review.notAvailableTitle: Measurement and saving are not available yet.
review.notAvailableBody: No symmetry score is calculated and these frames are not stored — they are discarded when you leave this page. Scan history and measurement will appear here once they are ready.

meta.title: Photo timeline — Palsya
meta.description: Every scan you have taken, side by side.

timeline.title: Photo timeline
timeline.fillsUp: Your timeline fills up one scan at a time. The first one is the baseline everything else is measured against.
